PROBLEM 2
CLINICAL SAFETY CONCERNS
Wrong medication
Errors can occur when decisions and documentation happen under pressure.
Missed allergy history
A critical detail may be overlooked, increasing the risk of an adverse drug reaction.
Missed or delayed diagnosis
Limited time can make it harder to recognise uncommon or complex presentations.
Unnecessary investigations
Insufficient time for clinical reasoning can drive avoidable tests and costs.
These are risks associated with system pressure
